metadata.title: LatAD: Trained VaDE-hard+resid anomaly-detection checkpoints for WADI, HAI, and SKAB
metadata.description: Trained anomaly-detection model checkpoints accompanying the paper 'Modeling Normal Is All You Need: Joint Latent Clustering for Anomaly Detection in Multimodal Cyber-Physical Systems and the Industrial IoT'. One checkpoint per cyber-physical-system benchmark (WADI, HAI, SKAB), each the reported main model VaDE-hard+resid(auto): a Variational Deep Embedding with a Gaussian-mixture latent prior, scored in the latent by a mixture density and a nearest-component likelihood, with two optional heads auto-gated on train-normal signals and reconstruction dropped. Includes portable weights, fitted heads, standardisation statistics, full configuration (seed 0, reproducing the paper's numbers), a model card, and a minimal load-and-score example. Checkpoints contain learned parameters only, not raw data; the WADI/HAI/SKAB datasets are third-party benchmarks and are not redistributed.
